title: Maximizing Root
statementMd:
You are given a rooted tree consisting of $n$ vertices numbered from $1$ to $n$. Vertex $1$ is the root of the tree. Each vertex has an integer value. The value of $i$-th vertex is $a_i$. You can do the following operation at most $k$ times.

- Choose a vertex $v$ **that has not been chosen before** and an integer $x$ such that $x$ is a common divisor of the values of all vertices of the subtree of $v$. Multiply by $x$ the value of each vertex in the subtree of $v$.

What is the maximum possible value of the root node $1$ after at most $k$ operations? Formally, you have to maximize the value of $a_1$.

A tree is a connected undirected graph without cycles. A rooted tree is a tree with a selected vertex, which is called the root. The subtree of a node $u$ is the set of all nodes $y$ such that the simple path from $y$ to the root passes through $u$. Note that $u$ is in the subtree of $u$.

## Input

The first line contains an integer $t$ ($1 \leq t \leq 50\,000$) — the number of test cases. The description of the test cases follows.

The first line of each test case contains two integers $n$ and $k$ ($2 \leq n \leq 10^5$, $0 \leq k \leq n$) — the number of vertices in the tree and the number of operations.

The second line contains $n$ integers $a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_n$ ($1 \leq a_i \leq 1000$), where $a_i$ denotes the value of vertex $i$.

Each of the next $n - 1$ lines contains two integers $u_i$ and $v_i$ ($1 \leq u_i, v_i \leq n$, $u_i \neq v_i$), denoting the edge of the tree between vertices $u_i$ and $v_i$. It is guaranteed that the given edges form a tree.

It is guaranteed that the sum of $n$ over all test cases does not exceed $2 \cdot 10^5$.

## Output

For each test case, output the maximum value of the root after performing at most $k$ operations.

## Note

Both examples have the same tree:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8ed1a507028a5a7b1f2a38e311c67947a5bc4765.png)

For the first test case, you can do two operations as follows:

- Choose the subtree of vertex $4$ and $x = 2$. ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7ff9ca71025b809db120b6a3a06f36341eff4ae3.png) After this operation, the node values become $\{24, 12, 24, 12, 12\}.$
- Choose the subtree of vertex $1$ and $x = 12$. ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/31bacd3d15cf84cb59e5a6889daa7e0225f9f90d.png) After this operation, the node values become $\{288, 144, 288, 144, 144\}.$

The value of the root is $288$ and it is the maximum.

For the second test case, you can do three operations as follows:

- Choose the subtree of vertex $4$ and $x = 2$. ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7ff9ca71025b809db120b6a3a06f36341eff4ae3.png) After this operation, the node values become $\{24, 12, 24, 12, 12\}.$
- Choose the subtree of vertex $2$ and $x = 4$. ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4498b37fe15511a1e8b95046b70bb3b2a2dee677.png) After this operation, the node values become $\{24, 48, 24, 48, 48\}.$
- Choose the subtree of vertex $1$ and $x = 24$. ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6611be76ea7dc71c11dc46607ce4ad6b77dbd7dd.png) After this operation, the node values become $\{576, 1152, 576, 1152, 1152\}.$

The value of the root is $576$ and it is the maximum.
statementZhMd:
给定一棵由 $n$ 个顶点组成的有根树，顶点编号从 $1$ 到 $n$。顶点 $1$ 是树的根。每个顶点都有一个整数值，第 $i$ 个顶点的值为 $a_i$。你至多可以进行 $k$ 次以下操作。

- 选择一个**之前从未被选择过**的顶点 $v$，以及一个整数 $x$，满足 $x$ 是 $v$ 的子树中所有顶点的值的公约数。将该子树中每个顶点的值都乘以 $x$。

进行至多 $k$ 次操作后，根节点 $1$ 的值最大是多少？形式化地说，你需要最大化 $a_1$ 的值。

树是一个无环的连通无向图。有根树是在树中选定一个顶点作为根的树。节点 $u$ 的子树是所有满足以下条件的节点 $y$ 组成的集合：从 $y$ 到根的简单路径经过 $u$。注意，$u$ 也属于 $u$ 的子树。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $t$（$1 \leq t \leq 50\,000$）— 测试用例的数量。接下来是各个测试用例的描述。

每个测试用例的第一行包含两个整数 $n$ 和 $k$（$2 \leq n \leq 10^5$，$0 \leq k \leq n$）— 树的顶点数和操作次数。

第二行包含 $n$ 个整数 $a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_n$（$1 \leq a_i \leq 1000$），其中 $a_i$ 表示顶点 $i$ 的值。

接下来的 $n - 1$ 行中，每行包含两个整数 $u_i$ 和 $v_i$（$1 \leq u_i, v_i \leq n$，$u_i \neq v_i$），表示顶点 $u_i$ 和顶点 $v_i$ 之间的一条边。保证给出的边构成一棵树。

保证所有测试用例的 $n$ 之和不超过 $2 \cdot 10^5$。

## 输出格式

对于每个测试用例，输出进行至多 $k$ 次操作后根节点的最大值。

## 说明

两个样例使用同一棵树：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8ed1a507028a5a7b1f2a38e311c67947a5bc4765.png)

对于第一个测试用例，可以进行如下两次操作：

- 选择顶点 $4$ 的子树，并令 $x = 2$。![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7ff9ca71025b809db120b6a3a06f36341eff4ae3.png) 操作后，节点值变为 $\{24, 12, 24, 12, 12\}$。
- 选择顶点 $1$ 的子树，并令 $x = 12$。![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/31bacd3d15cf84cb59e5a6889daa7e0225f9f90d.png) 操作后，节点值变为 $\{288, 144, 288, 144, 144\}$。

根节点的值为 $288$，这是可能达到的最大值。

对于第二个测试用例，可以进行如下三次操作：

- 选择顶点 $4$ 的子树，并令 $x = 2$。![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7ff9ca71025b809db120b6a3a06f36341eff4ae3.png) 操作后，节点值变为 $\{24, 12, 24, 12, 12\}$。
- 选择顶点 $2$ 的子树，并令 $x = 4$。![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4498b37fe15511a1e8b95046b70bb3b2a2dee677.png) 操作后，节点值变为 $\{24, 48, 24, 48, 48\}$。
- 选择顶点 $1$ 的子树，并令 $x = 24$。![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6611be76ea7dc71c11dc46607ce4ad6b77dbd7dd.png) 操作后，节点值变为 $\{576, 1152, 576, 1152, 1152\}$。

根节点的值为 $576$，这是可能达到的最大值。
